questions.q: Which agency enforces food safety in a restaurant or foodservice operation?

choices.A: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
choices.D: U.S. Department of Agriculture

choices.A: identifying risks, creating specifications, and training.
choices.B: identifying risks, corrective action, and training.

choices.D: identifying risks, re-certifying equipment, and training.

choices.C: Determine if there is a significant risk to food

questions.q: A food handler who has just used their cell phone must do what before handling food?

choices.D: Wipe hands on a cloth towel

questions.q: As part of handwashing, food handlers must scrub their hands and arms with soap for at least

choices.D: 20 seconds.

questions.q: To work with food, a food handler with an infected hand wound must

choices.A: cover the wound with an impermeable cover and wear a single-use glove.

choices.D: Long and unpolished

questions.q: What should a manager of a quick-service operation do if a food handler reports having a sore throat and a fever?

choices.A: Exclude the food handler from the operation.
choices.B: Report the illness to the local regulatory authority.
choices.C: Speak with the food handler's medical practitioner.
choices.D: Restrict the food handler from working with exposed food, utensils, and equipment.

choices.A: Keep the food handler away from duties that involve food.

choices.C: Make sure the food handler is supplied with disposable gloves.
choices.D: Make sure the food handler washes hands often.

choices.C: kept away from customer parking areas.
